tasks.title: Slow nav hover expand with smooth CSS transitions
tasks.description: Hover was snapping height/padding instantly because only color properties were transitioned. Move hover styles into custom.css and animate height, padding, letter-spacing, and colors over ~0.7s ease-in-out.
tasks.details: Removed instant hover height jumps from header.html inline styles; custom.css now owns base + hover with 0.7s ease-in-out.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:
Nav link hover expands height and letter-spacing smoothly without a snap
Mobile collapse open/close feels slower than Bootstrap default
header.html no longer applies instant hover height jumps

tasks.title: Slow mobile navbar collapse open/close
tasks.description: Override Bootstrap .collapsing 0.35s height transition with a longer ease-in-out duration so the hamburger menu open/close feels smoother.
tasks.details: Set .navbar-collapse.collapsing and .collapsing to height 0.85s ease-in-out with !important to beat Bootstrap.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Hamburger menu open and close uses ~0.85s ease-in-out height transition

tasks.title: Unify thanks + footer across portfolio pages
tasks.description: Centralized Thanks + Certifications + Skills/Tools + social bar in footer.html. Updated index, about, brands, zipay, equinine, dont-show-nin, project-template, and dev pages to use the shared closing include (`footer.html?v=4` + `site-closing-wrap`).
tasks.details: Removed per-page Thanks markup; full-bleed thanks band CSS updated to break out of container wrappers consistently.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:
All main portfolio pages use the same thanks band + certifications + skills/tools + social footer from footer.html
No duplicate old Thanks markup remains on those pages
Footer load path and cache-bust are consistent

tasks.title: Double spacing between closing footer sections
tasks.description: Doubled vertical gaps between Thanks, Certifications, and Skills/Tools in css/custom.css.
tasks.details: thanks margin-bottom 3rem→6rem; certs margin-bottom 3rem→6rem; site-footer padding-top 2.5rem→5rem.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:
Gap between Thanks and Certifications is roughly 2x previous
Gap between Certifications and Skills/Tools is roughly 2x previous

tasks.title: Nudge brand name size down to match job title
tasks.description: Reduce .brand-name from 1.72em to 1.55em so width aligns with job title.
tasks.details: Also mobile 1.65em → 1.5em; cache bust custom.css v=11.

tasks.title: Make About quote signature white via CSS filter
tasks.description: Apply brightness(0) invert(1) so the signature reads white on the dark About page.

tasks.title: Enlarge About quote signature
tasks.description: Increase signature max-width from 11.5rem to 18rem and left-align under the quote.

tasks.title: Update about timeline: 2016 + CEO @ Inject 2026
tasks.description: Change 2016–Present to 2016 and add 2026 – Present CEO @ Inject chapter on about.html.
tasks.details: Updated about.html chapters; 2016 year label shortened; new CEO @ Inject chapter with R&D company description.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:
2016 year has no Present suffix
New 2026 – Present CEO @ Inject chapter with R&D company description

tasks.title: Widen collapsed project back button to show Go
tasks.description: Default .back-btn max-width was 50px so only the arrow and letter G were visible. Increase collapsed max-width so visitors see Go; hover still expands to full Go back.
tasks.details: Increased .back-btn collapsed max-width from 50px to 85px so arrow + Go are visible; hover still expands to Go back. Cache-bust custom.css to v=16 on equinine, zipay, brands, dont-show-nin, project-template.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:
Collapsed back button shows arrow + Go
Hover expands to full Go back text
